sigma_V.label: ADOPTED-NOT-YET-APPLIED (E1.2, full-scale recovery study 30 Aug 2026): estimator C is the only usable estimator by the pre-registered rule (median relative error 0.05 at its own cell, A fails on coverage, B is not identified), so its sigma_V = 0.01957 [0.01892, 0.02036] is the adopted FIT. It is NOT yet written into the generator: sigma_V changes every path, so applying it triggers the plan's execution-order rule (E1.4, E1.5, E1.1 and the Phase-1 after-state were all measured at 0.006). The value in force stays v2's stipulated 0.006 until the team decides whether to re-run the cascade now or fold the change into Phase 2's engine re-fit — DECISION_LOG P1-15. Caveat carried with the adoption: the recovery panels come from C's own model, so the usability test favours C by construction, and C's J = 66.6 on the real panel shows the model does not fit the data well.
